product_one_liner.value: Horizon3’s NodeZero provides autonomous penetration testing for security teams to uncover exploitable attack paths, prioritize remediation, and verify fixes.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes pentests that uncover exploitable paths, guide remediation, and verify fixes; the documentation identifies security analysts and related technical users as its audience. Sources: https://horizon3.ai/product/nodezero and https://docs.horizon3.ai/.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists NodeZero Flex and Core packages. Listed numerical prices are not required by the question: https://horizon3.ai/pricing.

eng_blog.notes: Under the question’s strict definition, the reviewed indices and posts did not establish two engineer-authored articles about building the product. The blog index primarily shows customer, product, and security-strategy content. The MCP-server architecture article is a detailed build-oriented exception, but no individual engineering author is identified; the AI-defense article is corporately attributed. Sources: https://horizon3.ai/category/intelligence/blogs, https://horizon3.ai/intelligence/blogs/securing-the-nodezero-mcp-server-building-a-safe-agent-ready-runtime-for-enterprises, and https://horizon3.ai/attack-research/attack-blogs/autonomous-ai-cyber-defense-safe-production/.
